_notes: Stage 6 prototype set under correction after Stage 7 pass 002 (findings F-001..F-009; F-001..F-006 returned to Stage 6), written by UX Designer UX-006-14 at 2026-10-05T12:21:56Z (UTC from code); F-001..F-004 and F-006 are corrected by local edits and F-002 by the candidate option C (permission-conditioned states), all for the next Stage 7 pass to judge. It is NOT clean, NOT a Stage 7 control and NOT owner approval; Stage 6 is not complete.

Claims: a row is claimed when its element is drawn in the screen files (D) or when it is a listed state, overlay or navigation shown by a pattern whose composition is unchanged and is drawn in a real export (P); the claimed rows of each screen are its workbook_rows. After Stage 7 pass 001 the claims that relied on a pattern with a different composition, or on a trigger without a drawn destination, were withdrawn and are now drawn by the UX-006-13 exports. No visual row is unclaimed. Rows 24 and 26 are role states drawn by iteration-export-menu-desktop and task-viewer-desktop; row 210 is drawn by the export menu (iteration-export-menu-desktop).

Roles (Stage 7 pass 001 F-001/F-002): each screen declares the roles its exports draw; role views are states of the same screen. iteration-page: admin (list-desktop, list-phone: Edit and Delete iteration), editor (iteration-export-menu-desktop: no Delete iteration) and viewer (iteration-viewer-desktop: read-only); task-page: editor and viewer (task-viewer-desktop); projects-list: Create project and the System information link for the system administrator (rows 24, 55); the Hidden column follows the hide permission (present: projects-list-desktop and projects-list-hide-desktop; absent: projects-list-member-desktop; rows 76, 81), whose role mapping is deferred to SDD (D-001, D-011; Stage 7 pass 002 F-002 candidate option C); project-page: system administrator (Delete project); people-list: admin and system administrator (Create person; for viewers and editors only that button is absent). Also drawn: projects-list for viewer/editor/admin, project-page admin (export menu), story-page viewer (export menu), person-page viewer, person-editor project admin. The phone date picker, the select inside a phone dialog and the phone empty state are drawn by iteration-editor-phone, continue-dialog-phone and iteration-empty-phone.
